prompt: In a video game your coins TRIPLE at the end of every level. You start with $1$ coin. After how many levels do you have $81$ coins?
hint: Tripling each level is repeated multiplication by $3$. How many threes multiply to make $81$?

hints.text: Tripling each level is repeated multiplication by $3$. How many threes multiply to make $81$?
This is the question $\log_3(81)$. Triple your way up from $1$ coin: $1, 3, 9, 27, 81$, and count the triplings.
It takes four triplings because $3^4 = 81$, so you need $4$ levels.

explanation: Tripling at each level means that after $x$ levels you have $3^x$ coins.
You need $3^x = 81$, which is the same question that $\log_3(81)$ asks.
Since $3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 = 81$, the exponent is $x = 4$, so it takes $4$ levels.

alternativeExplanations.title: Make a level list
steps: Counting the rows gives $4$ — a log is just counting the steps.
